implementation.dispatch_rail: CountingRail.dispatch is called only by record_run; replay_run never references .dispatch (AST)
implementation.missing_input_policy: name the field; never invent a plan

negative_controls.description: A complete log replays ok with an empty missing_inputs list. Dropping workflow yields missing_inputs=['workflow'] and plan=None.
A DynamicFanOut log without fanout_materialized names events.fanout_materialized instead of inventing shard ids from the hostname.
Injecting hostname into a recorded plan makes replay_run return ok=False and names the leak path; it does not succeed by copying the leaky plan through.
record_run increments CountingRail (2 WorkUnits); replay_run leaves a fresh rail at 0. A stuck-at-zero counter would fail the live half.
